Description: Time (in seconds) since the start of the recording
Usage: Helpful to detect which direction traveled for naming datasets
From: Sensor Logger recordings

Description: Date-time object containing the date and exact time of each point in the recording
Usage: For time series graphs, order
From: Sensor Logger recordings

Description: Acceleration in the x direction, left and right. Adjusted to represent positive values as right and negative as left
Usage: Used to calculate L2 norm along with Y and Z acceleration
From: Transformed variable originally from Sensor Logger recordings

Description: Acceleration in the y direction, up and down. Adjusted to represent positive values as up and negative values as down
Usage: Used to calculate L2 norm along with X and Z acceleration
From: Transformed variable originally from Sensor Logger recordings

Description: Acceleration in the z direction, forward and backward. Represents positive values as forward and negative values as backward
Usage: Used to calculate L2 norm along with x and Y acceleration
From: Sensor Logger recordings

Description: Magnitude of acceleration. Calculated using L2_norm = sqrt(x^2 + y^2 + z^2) where x, y, and z are the directions of acceleration
Usage: One way to represent road quality. Includes all acceleration changes regardless of direction into one measurement
From: New variable from other transformed and non transformed variables originally from Sensor Logger recordings

Description: Name of the street that the line represents. Naming conventions are as follows: Name of street + Direction. For Snelling Ave which has lanes, right lane is R and left lane is L. For Summit Ave that has side streets in either direction, S stands for side street. These specifications are added to the end of original naming convention if necessary
Usage: Created for popup in leaflet map showing magnitude of acceleration
From: Created using data naming conventions from test mapping each individual recording to check which street. Test mapping code can be found in the recordings.qmd file

Description: Name of the "base street" the line represents. Using the street_name variable naming conventions, this variable will take only the Name of street part as the variable. This way we have a variable that stores the names non-directionally for easy grouping.
Usage: Created for magnitude of acceleration line charts. Instead of having 17 separate charts for each segment measured, each direction and/or lane for a street is in one graph with different colored lines to differentiate. This reduces number of individual charts to 8 for easier viewing. Also used for summary tables in order to see general trends for each base street.
From: Created using first part of naming convention for street_name variable created from original data

Description: Number of lines for magnitude of acceleration line chart to determine number of colors needed in one plot for each line to be different color. Based on number of same base_streets in one time
Usage: Used for colors in magnitude of acceleration line charts
From: Created using counts of base_streets per time of recording

Description: Red color for lines, stored as hex values
Usage: Used for colors in magnitude of acceleration line charts
From: Dependent on variables line_count and base_street

Description: Spatial aspect of the data. Explains the data is points and gives spatial details for mapping

From: New variable from latitude and longitude from Sensor Logger recordings raw data
